dct_description_sm: This dataset contains the data used in the paper "Effects of forest management on mercury bioaccumulation and biomagnification along the river continuum." The dataset contains stable isotope data and total or methyl mercury concentrations collected on water, course particulate organic matter (CPOM), fine particulate organic matter (FPOM), seston, biofilm, invertebrates, and fish. These data were collected to study the effects of forest management on mercury bioaccumulation and biomagnification in food webs along a stream continuum.
